capabilities: Indent headings and body blocks by heading ancestry
Treat the first heading as depth zero regardless of level
Draw one guide line per parent heading and color it from that heading
Keep native fold arrows visible on their guide lines
Configure guide, arrow, color, and width settings
extras: No community-plugin store install is described; the README only covers manual installation by copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into the plugins folder, with a separate Android procedure noting that hidden dot-folders may need a special file manager.
problem: Obsidian gives no visual indentation of content under headings, so the heading hierarchy of a long note is hard to see while reading or editing.
summary: Editor plugin that indents headings and body blocks by their heading ancestry and draws a configurable colored guide line per parent heading.
